intro_zh: 本課將學習過去簡單式中不規則動詞的變化，例如 go→went、have→had、am/is→was、are→were。透過旅行故事，學生練習用這些動詞說明過去的經驗。
can_do: 能用 went、had、was、were 描述自己過去的旅行經驗。
能閱讀並理解含有過去簡單式不規則動詞的短文。
能口頭分享自己曾經參加的節慶或旅行故事。

sentences.en: Mei-Ling went to Japan by airplane and arrived at the airport.
sentences.zh: 美玲坐飛機去日本，並到達機場。

sentences.en: She celebrated a cherry blossom festival with her family there.
sentences.zh: 她在那裡與家人一起慶祝櫻花節。

sentences.en: Next, she took a train to Korea and visited a busy station.
sentences.zh: 接著，她搭火車去韓國，並參觀了一個繁忙的車站。

sentences.en: In Korea she received a nice present from a friend at the station.
sentences.zh: 她在韓國的車站裡，從朋友那裡收到一份很好的禮物。

sentences.en: Then she flew to Singapore and saw a vibrant festival.
sentences.zh: 然後，她飛往新加坡，看到了一個熱鬧的節慶。

sentences.en: After that, she traveled to Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines to try local food.
sentences.zh: 之後，她前往泰國、越南和菲律賓，嘗試當地美食。

sentences.en: She also visited Malaysia, Canada, Australia, England, France, Germany, India, and Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 她也去了馬來西亞、加拿大、澳洲、英國、法國、德國、印度和香港。

sentences.en: In each country she had fun and learned about its festivals.
sentences.zh: 在每個國家，她玩得很開心，並學習當地的節慶。

sentences.en: At the end, she was happy and her friends were excited.
sentences.zh: 最後，她感到很高興，而她的朋友也很興奮。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 不規則動詞三態對照表
grammar_points.explain_zh: 以下是常用不規則動詞的原形、過去式與過去分詞，必須背誦。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② be 動詞的過去式 was／were 隨主詞變化
grammar_points.explain_zh: was 用於 I、he、she、it 與單數名詞；were 用於 you、we、they 與複數名詞。

examples.en: I was at the airport yesterday.
She was happy to see the parade.
We were excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 我們對這次旅行很興奮。

examples.en: They were tired after the flight.
You were late for the festival.

lines.en: I went to Korea with my family last month.
lines.zh: 我上個月和家人去韓國。

lines.en: We had a great time at the lantern festival.
lines.zh: 我們在燈籠節玩得很開心。

lines.en: I saw beautiful lanterns floating in the river.
lines.zh: 我看見漂亮的燈籠在河裡浮著。

lines.en: It was fun and we were not tired.
We want to go again next year.

sentences.en: I went to Japan last winter.
We had a wonderful time at the festival.
sentences.zh: 我們在節慶裡玩得很開心。

sentences.en: She saw fireworks over the harbour.
sentences.zh: 她看見港口上空的煙火。

sentences.en: They flew to Thailand for Songkran.
sentences.zh: 他們飛往泰國參加สงกราน節。

sentences.en: It was fun to try new food.
He was surprised by the friendly people.
sentences.zh: 他被友善的人們驚到了。

sentences.en: We were tired after the long flight.
sentences.zh: 長時間飛行後我們很累。

sentences.en: The trip was amazing and we want to go again.
sentences.zh: 這次旅行很驚人，我們想再去一次。

focus: 過去簡單式（不規則動詞）
grammar: 常用動詞的過去式不加 -ed，要另外記：go→went、have→had、am/is→was、are→were。

mcq.q: They ______ a present for the festival. (有)
We ______ a present at the festival yesterday. (有)
The plane is at the ______. (在機場)

fill.q: She ____ to the airport yesterday.（她昨天去了機場）
They ____ a present for me.（他們曾經給我一份禮物）
We ____ at the station yesterday.（我們昨天在車站）
The present is ____ the station.（禮物在車站）
We met at the ____ yesterday.（我們昨天在___見面）
The festival was held in ____ last year.（去年節日在___舉辦）
She went to Singapore by ____.（她搭飛機去新加坡）

translate.ans: I went to the airport yesterday.
He went to Japan last summer.
We were at the station yesterday.
The festival was held in France last year.
She went to Singapore by plane.
The present is at the station.

unscramble.q: We / . / airport / went / yesterday / to / the
unscramble.ans: We went to the airport yesterday.

unscramble.q: present / friend / . / had / a / for / She / her
unscramble.ans: She had a present for her friend.

unscramble.q: festival / in / last / Thailand / year / The / . / was
unscramble.ans: The festival was in Thailand last year.

unscramble.q: . / He / last / the / station / at / night / was
unscramble.ans: He was at the station last night.

unscramble.q: . / celebrated / festival / the / in / Korea / They
unscramble.ans: They celebrated the festival in Korea.

unscramble.q: Singapore / . / plane / by / to / went / I
unscramble.ans: I went to Singapore by plane.
